description: The history operation on the Whisper control plane, served as CALL whisper.agents({op:'history', args:{...}}). Requires your Whisper API key. The identifier in the example is a placeholder for one of YOUR agents: list them with the "agents.list" skill and {"kind":"agents"}. Example call: {"skill":"agents.history","input":{"address":"2a04:2a01:f6d7:1ffe:a0be:ba8a:c355:bba1"}} Needs a linked Whisper account (OAuth) or your API key in the X-API-Key header.

input.description: Arguments for this operation, as an object. The example passes {"address":"2a04:2a01:f6d7:1ffe:a0be:ba8a:c355:bba1"}.

name: whisper_agents_history

outputSchema.description: A tabular graph answer: the column names, the rows keyed by them, and the cost.

columns.description: The column names, in order. Every row object has exactly these keys, so this is the row shape and reading it is cheaper than inspecting a row.

rows.description: The answers, one object per row, keyed by the column names above. An empty array means the question was understood and nothing matched, which is an answer and not a failure.

title: agents: history
